JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Summary

Responsible for accurate and timely intake and interpretation of regulatory and/or functional requirements related to but not limited to coverage, reimbursement, and processing functions to support systems solutions development and maintenance. This role includes coordination with stakeholders and subject matter experts on partnering teams and supporting governance committees where applicable.

JOB DUTIES

  • Develops and maintains requirement documents related to coverage, reimbursement and other applicable system changes in areas to ensure alignment to regulatory baseline requirements and any health plan developed requirements.
  • Monitors sources to ensure all updates are aligned.
  • Leads coordinated development and ongoing management /interpretation review process, committee structure and timing with key partner organizations.
  • Conducts analysis to identify root cause and assist with problem management as it relates to state requirements.
  • Communicates requirement interpretations and changes to health plans/product team and various impacted corporate core functional areas for requirement interpretation alignment and approvals as well as solution traceability through regular meetings and other operational process best practices.
  • Provides support for requirement interpretation inconsistencies and complaints.
  • Self-organized reporting to ensure health plans/product team and other leadership are aware of work efforts and impact for any prospective or retrospective requirement changes that can impact financials.
  • Engages with operations leadership and Plan Support functions to review compliance-based issues for benefit planning purposes.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Maintains relationships with Health Plans/Product Team and Corporate Operations to ensure all end-to-end business requirements have been documented and interpretation is agreed on and clear for solutioning.
  • Ability to meet aggressive timelines and balance multiple lines of business, states, and requirement areas.
  • Strong interpersonal and (oral and written) communication skills and ability to communicate with those in all positions of the company.
  • Ability to concisely synthesize large and complex requirements.
  • Ability to organize and maintain regulatory data including real-time policy changes.
  • Self-motivated and ability to take initiative, identify, communicate, and resolve potential problems.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Ability to work with those in other time zones than your own.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in previous roles in a managed care organization, health insurance or directly adjacent field, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Policy/government legislative review knowledge.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Robust knowledge of Office Product Suite including Word, Excel, Outlook and Teams.
  • Previous success in a dynamic and autonomous work environment.
  • Power BI

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project implementation experience
  • Knowledge and experience with federal regulatory policy resources including Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and the Affordable Care Act (ACA).

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

As an Engineering Manager, you will drive the successful delivery and execution of projects within your teams. You will manage end-to-end technical planning, ensuring that product requirements are translated into actionable tasks, while orchestrating collaboration between various stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, QA, and UX. This role requires a deep understanding of software design and development and the ability to plan, execute, and deliver product features in a timely and predictable manner. You will also be responsible for maintaining high technical standards, managing team bandwidth, and ensuring project milestones are met with efficiency and accuracy.

What you’ll get to do

  • Own end-to-end delivery and execution across cross-functional teams within your product area, ensuring predictable and high-quality outcomes.
  • Evaluate business and product requirements for technical feasibility and architectural alignment, translating them into well-defined EPICs and technical user stories.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Engineers to continuously refine, groom, and prioritize the backlog.
  • Plan and drive sprint execution with clearly defined goals, using project planning tools to establish timelines, delivery milestones, and surface dependencies early.
  • Champion engineering processes and rituals that enable strong collaboration, accountability, and team efficiency.
  • Monitor team velocity and capacity to optimize resource allocation, proactively balancing bandwidth against delivery commitments.
  • Coordinate cross-team dependencies and stakeholder alignment to remove bottlenecks and maintain smooth execution.
  • Stay hands-on in critical initiatives by guiding design decisions, enforcing sound design patterns, and participating in code reviews to maintain high engineering quality.
  • Ensure robust monitoring, alerting, and observability for all owned services, consistently meeting defined SLIs and SLOs.
  • Partner with Product Managers to define, track, and publish post-release product metrics, driving transparency and continuous improvement.

To succeed in this role, you should have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 8-10 years of experience as a Software Developer, Software Engineer, or in a similar hands-on technical role.
  • 5+ years of strong experience building production systems using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Minimum 3 years of proven engineering leadership experience managing high-performing teams.
  • Solid grasp of Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and iterative delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex product requirements into well-structured EPICs, user stories, and tasks.
  • Strong backend engineering expertise; exposure to frontend technologies is a plus.
  • Experience with project planning and tracking tools to visualize and manage delivery timelines.
  • Familiarity with engineering, product health metrics, and monitoring tools to drive data-informed decisions.
  • Hands-on capability to debug complex production issues, lead incident response, and conduct blameless RCA.
  • Good understanding of modern deployment practices, including CI/CD pipelines, release management, and associated metrics.
  • Ability to drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
  • Excellent risk management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Proven track record of improving team velocity, delivery predictability, and engineering excellence.

Generic Skills

  • Problem-solving: Ability to assess complex problems, find solutions, and make sound decisions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and stakeholder reporting.
  • Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment, adjusting strategies as needed.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous in documenting technical requirements and ensuring all aspects of a project are accounted for.

Supervisory skills

  • Team Management: Experience in managing and mentoring engineers, ensuring team growth and performance.
  • Resource Allocation: Ability to assess bandwidth and manage resource distribution to optimize team performance.
  • Feedback: Conduct regular performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and fostering a growth-oriented environment.
  • Stakeholder Management: Lead project status reviews, manage expectations, and ensure smooth communication between teams and leadership.

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

About the team

The Senior Specialist, Business Intelligence leverages advanced analytics, data modeling, and visualization to translate complex business questions into actionable insights that inform strategic and operational decisions. Partnering closely with product, marketing, and operations stakeholders, this role designs and maintains robust BI solutions and self-service reporting, improves data quality and accessibility, and mentors others on data-driven decision making.

About the role

Define the vision: For each marketing domain, leading with a strong point of view on what the end-state intelligence product should be, informed by stakeholder input and an understanding of today’s gaps, and building a strategic case for what to build, for whom, and why

Strategic thought partner to marketing leaders: Pressure-testing what stakeholders think they need, challenging assumptions, and aligning on the intelligence investments that will have the greatest impact on decisions and outcomes

Translate strategy into specs: Outlining mockups, data requirements, and prioritized feature sets with enough detail for BI analysts to build from, prototyping and validating concepts using available data and tools before committing to full builds

Drive adoption post-launch: Monitoring usage, diagnosing where adoption stalls, and iterating on products until they are embedded in day-to-day workflows

Incorporate AI capabilities: Defining AI-related needs where they make products more actionable such as automated insight surfacing, anomaly detection, or natural language interaction

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $118,600.00 - $189,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $112,700.00 - $179,900.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 8+ years in marketing analytics, media analytics, or strategic analytics -ideally shaping analytical approaches and recommendations, not just executing against predefined briefs. Experience at analytics consultancies, media agencies, or specialized firms (e.g., marketing mix, attribution) highly valued

  • Marketing fluency: Strong familiarity with marketing data and analytics needs, including deep fluency in at least one domain such as paid media, owned media, or marketing measurement

  • Business acumen: Able to quickly grasp business context and objectives, ensuring that marketing insights, performance metrics, and intelligence products directly connect to core business outcomes

  • Hands-on technical skills: Experience with SQL and dashboarding tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI), with the ability to work directly with data to prototype and iterate

  • Consultative mindset: Track record of digging into how stakeholders make decisions, pushing past surface-level requests, and delivering higher-impact solutions

  • Executive communication: Able to present a strategic point of view with clarity and confidence, and challenge constructively while maintaining trust

  • Strategic agility: Able to ramp quickly in unfamiliar areas, build credibility with new stakeholder groups, and independently structure a path forward

  • AI curiosity: Genuine interest in experimenting with AI tools and incorporating AI-augmented capabilities into analytics work; deep expertise not required

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s in a quantitative or business field (MBA, MSBA, Economics, Statistics) a plus

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Position Summary

B&G Foods is seeking an experienced Supplier Quality Manager to lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of supplier quality and food safety programs across our ingredients within the spice, seasoning, seed, herb and flavor/additives supply base. This position is responsible for ensuring suppliers meet B&G Foods' quality, food safety, regulatory, and customer requirements while driving risk reduction and continuous improvement throughout the supply chain.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in supplier quality management within the food manufacturing industry, with significant experience in the spices, seasonings, herbs, dehydrated ingredients, and flavor systems. This role requires strong technical knowledge of supplier approval and monitoring programs, food safety auditing, regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and supplier performance management.

Essential Responsibilities

Supplier Qualification & Approval

  • Lead the supplier approval, qualification, and requalification programs for ingredients including: spices, seasonings, herbs, dehydrated ingredients, and flavor systems.
  • Evaluate supplier food safety systems, quality management systems, regulatory compliance, and operational capabilities.
  • Perform risk-based supplier assessments and establish supplier risk ratings.
  • Review supplier documentation and support onboarding of new suppliers and ingredients in TraceGains.

Supplier Auditing

  • Conduct supplier audits and assessments at domestic and international manufacturing facilities.
  • Issue audit reports and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).
  • Monitor supplier corrective action effectiveness and closure.
  • Partner with Procurement to address supplier performance concerns and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with suppliers on risk reduction strategies specific to spice and seasoning ingredient supply chains.

Supplier Performance Management

  • Develop and maintain supplier scorecards and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Analyze supplier performance trends related to:
    • Audit results, Complaints, Non-conformances, CaPA effectiveness
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives with strategic suppliers.
  • Lead supplier business reviews with cross-functional teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Procurement, Operations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to ensure supplier compliance and business continuity.
  • Support project and product commercialization activities within the Spice/Seasonings Business Unit.
  • Provide supplier quality expertise for investigations, recalls, withdrawals, and supplier-related incidents.
  • Participate in crisis management and supply chain risk mitigation efforts.
  • Support internal and external audits.
  • Maintain supplier quality procedures, policies, and standards.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Food Engineering, Agricultural Sciences, or related scientific/technical discipline.
  • Minimum 7 years of food manufacturing experience with 5 years’ experience in supplier quality, food safety and/or supply chain.
  • Demonstrated experience auditing food manufacturing facilities.
  • Experience managing supplier corrective actions and continuous improvement programs.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 50%.

Preferred

  • Experience in the spice, seasoning, herb, flavor, botanical, or agricultural ingredient industries.
  • Lead Auditor certification.
  • PCQI certification.
  • Experience with global sourcing and international supplier networks.
  • Knowledge of food fraud, food defense, and ingredient authenticity programs.
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers and co-manufacturers.

Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

Overview

We are looking for a Director, UX Researchto join the Customer Insights team at Collectors and lead our UX research function. This is an exciting time to join the growing collectibles space. This role will have the unique opportunity to shape a suite of products to help card collectors grade, sell, manage and enjoy their collections.

You will lead the UX research team to deeply understand the people behind the collections and how our products can meet their needs. We need a leader who is skilled at prioritizing what research will drive the biggest impact and weighing how different research methods are best suited for each ask.

Remote or hybrid candidates (close to Santa Ana or Jersey City offices) will be considered. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.

What You’ll Do

  • Set Research Strategy: Define and drive the UX research roadmap by identifying critical knowledge gaps and prioritizing work that influences company-level decisions.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a senior partner to Marketing, Product, Design, and Engineering leads to weave the right insights together and drive decision making.

  • Execute Research: Both independently conduct andguide team members on the design and execution of generative, formative, and summative research to support product design and development (including but not limited to ethnography, interviews, surveys, concept testing, and usability studies)

  • Team Leadership: Mentor the user research team. Set clear direction, mentor team members, and establish a high bar for research craft.

Who You Are

  • Experienced UX Leader: 7+ years of experience in user research, preferably with experience in consumer technology, collectibles, sports or fandom. You are an experienced people manager (2+ years of experience). You know what "excellent" looks like and how to coach others to get there.

  • Master of Craft: You possess a broad methodology range (qualitative and quantitative) and have a track record of research that has moved the needle on real-world business outcomes. You have the ability to moderate interviews and conduct user research independently.

  • Strategic Thinker: You can translate ambiguous problem spaces into clear research questions and connect findings to product strategy with confidence. You understand when different data points/methodology is required to make the most compelling case (e.g., primary research vs. behavioral data, usability vs. market research study, etc.).

  • Master Storyteller: You can land a narrative regardless of the audience—from a small product squad to a senior leadership forum.

  • Collaborative Partner: You build buy-in and navigate competing priorities with grace. You are known as an honest, transparent partner at every level of the organization.

  • Adaptable & Tech-Forward: You understand how AI is transforming research. You encourage experimentation with new tools while holding the line on quality and rigor.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $163,308 - $267,038. Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation.

Reasons To Join Us

  • Health Insurance: All full-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • Additional Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits

  • 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals

  • Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time-off

  • Holiday Pay: All regular, full-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays

  • Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions

  • Flexible Hours: Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs

  • Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities

Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!
As a Senior Software Developer, you operate as a technical leader within your team and across the broader engineering organization. You shape architecture and design, raise the bar on engineering quality, mentor other developers, and partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate technical decisions into business value. You are equally comfortable guiding agentic-AI tools to deliver code, reviewing designs, and influencing how the platform evolves.

What you will do:

    • Create architecture, prototypes, and design proposals that deliver near-term business value while aligning with the future-state product and platform vision.

    • Influence technical direction through architecture reviews, RFCs, design discussions, and hands-on collaboration.

    • Partner with senior developers, architects, and tech leads to define and execute the product/platform architecture roadmap.

    • Balance delivery speed, quality, maintainability, and long-term platform health when making technical decisions.

    • Break down large initiatives into parallelizable chunks of work that deliver incremental business value.

    • Champion proposals through all phases of the SDLC, from design through production implementation.

    • Contribute to improving the core product build, CI/CD pipelines, and overall SDLC.

    • Troubleshoot and eliminate root causes of persistent production issues; drive reliability, observability, monitoring, and incident response.

    • Keep technical documentation current and create new artifacts as needed.

    • Facilitate design discussions within and across teams.

    • Represent the team in technical discussions with Tech Leads, Operations, Product/UX, Security, Domain SMEs, and external stakeholders.

    • Act as a trusted technical leader, helping teams succeed through collaboration, influence, and shared ownership.

    • Mentor other developers through design reviews, joint agentic-AI sessions, and feedback on skills, prompts, and other agent inputs; contribute to raising overall engineering maturity.

    • Share knowledge of new technologies and industry best practices.

    • Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and cloud capabilities that could benefit the platform.

    AI-Augmented Development Expectations

    • Use AI-assisted development tools — inline completion, conversational assistants, and agentic workflows — as a standard part of your daily workflow.

    • Critically evaluate and take ownership of all AI-generated output before it ships — verify correctness, security, and alignment with architecture and team standards.

    • Identify opportunities for agentic automation within your team, and lead the rollout of new AI-assisted workflows and tooling.

    • Mentor other developers on effective, responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

    • Help establish team-level practices and guardrails for using AI tools safely and effectively.

    • Build and refine feedback loops that improve the team's collective use of AI tooling over time.

    Developer Platform Focus

    • Define and evolve the architecture of the internal developer platform, including monorepo structure, build systems, and CI/CD pipelines.

    • Influence technical direction for platform tooling through design reviews, RFCs, and hands-on collaboration.

    • Partner with engineering teams to improve developer experience and reduce friction across the SDLC.

    • Mentor engineers on monorepo management and CI/CD best practices.

What you wll bring:

    • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; 8+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrated impact beyond a single team.

    • 8+ years of professional experience, with deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and Nx monorepo architecture at scale.

    • Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions or equivalent) for multiple teams.

    • Proven experience designing and operating distributed, cloud-native, SaaS/multi-tenant platforms at scale, ideally on AWS.

    • Strong software fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, SOLID principles, and a track record of advocating for code quality.

    • Experience with agentic-AI software development practices.

    • Experience designing and consuming well-designed HTTP APIs (REST, GraphQL, or similar).

    • Experience mentoring developers and influencing architectural decisions across teams.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.

    • Strong initiative to improve processes, tools, methodologies, and product quality.

    • Experience with AWS.

    • Familiarity with containerization technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.

Technical Stack:

    1. Framework: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS

    1. Styling: HTML5, CSS3/SASS

    1. Testing: Jest, Cypress, Playwright

    1. Design Systems: Storybook or equivalent component library tooling

    1. Accessibility: WCAG 2.1

    1. Tooling: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Nx Monorep

What's in it for you:

▪️Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions.
▪️We are committed to a collaborative culture, where your ideas are valued, and knowledge sharing is encouraged within a supportive, inclusive team.
▪️Work-life balance is important to us. We offer flexible work options, remote opportunities, and generous time-off policies to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
▪️We offer competitive compensation, including a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits such as health insurance and retirement plans.
▪️We are driven by impactful work. Your contributions directly affect how our clients manage financial processes and drive their success.
▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us. We celebrate hard work through recognition programs, performance bonuses, and opportunities for career growth.
▪️We embrace global opportunities. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team.

About Caseware:

Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Our teams are continually collaborating, innovating, and building upon our existing suite of products. With a customer-focused mindset, we are building technology that is shaping what the future of audits, financial reporting, and financial data analytics will look like.
With a recent strategic investment from Hg Capital in 2020, Caseware is now in its next major growth phase as we double down on the people and products that have made Caseware so successful to date.
One of Caseware's core values is Many Voices, One Team and with that in mind, we're dedicated to building teams as diverse as our customers in an equitable and inclusive way. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Should you require accommodations or have any questions at any point during the application or interview process, please e-mail our People Operations team at .

AI Usage:

The recruitment process may use AI assisted tools but not for candidate screening or assessment. All final hiring decisions are made by humans to ensure fairness, transparency, and oversight.

Background Check:

Any candidates successful in obtaining an offer for a position will need to successfully complete a background check through Certn.co which typically includes an Identity Verification and Criminal Record Check. Executives and Senior Managers will undergo a Soft Credit Check as well. Candidates residing in the Netherlands and Germany are excluded from undergoing background checks via Certn.co

Security and Fraud:

Caseware takes the security of candidates seriously. All legitimate communication from us will come from email addresses ending in @caseware.com and our open positions are always listed on reputable job boards and on our website We will NEVER ask for payment or financial information from you. raw.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.

About Binance Accelerator Program

Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.

Who may apply

Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

Responsibility

  • Contribute to backend and/or full-stack feature development, testing, and release for core products/platforms, delivering production-ready code.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on module design, API/interface definition, system integration, and deployment (including logging, monitoring, and performance optimization).
  • Write and maintain automated tests and CI/CD-related configurations to improve development efficiency and code quality.
  • Support the engineering deployment of AI/LLM capabilities based on business needs, such as integrating LLM APIs, building basic RAG pipelines, and embedding tool/agent capabilities into existing systems.
  • Help build and maintain datasets and benchmarks for evaluation/regression, track online performance, and assist with debugging and fixing issues.
  • Produce necessary technical documentation and communicate effectively across teams.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: data structures and algorithms, object-oriented design, common design patterns, and coding best practices.
  • Proficient in at least one primary programming language for engineering work; Python is required. Experience with Java/Go/TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus.
  • Familiar with common engineering tools and workflows: Git, basic Linux, debugging skills; understanding of unit/integration testing, RESTful APIs, and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Some AI/LLM project or internship experience is sufficient (no deep research required), e.g., prompt engineering/function calling, RAG, vector databases, or experience integrating frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph is a plus.
  • Strong ownership, good communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to learn quickly and deliver.
  • Able to commit to at least 6 months, 5 days per week.

Nice to Have

  • Experience shipping web/backend services; knowledge of caching, message queues, concurrency, and performance tuning.
  • Familiarity with containerization and deployment (Docker/Kubernetes), cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), or observability (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK).
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, prompt iteration, data feedback loops, or basic fine-tuning workflows.
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Best Office Staff is seeking a compassionate and detail-oriented Patient Care Specialist to join our team. This role is critical in ensuring a positive experience for our patients from their first interaction with the clinic through their ongoing care. The ideal candidate will have a strong commitment to exceptional patient service, excellent communication skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast-paced, patient-centered environment.

Responsibilities

  • Patient Interaction: Greet and check in patients with a friendly, welcoming demeanor. Guide them through the intake process, answer questions, and ensure they feel comfortable.
  • Scheduling Appointments: Efficiently schedule and confirm patient appointments, ensuring minimal wait times and optimal clinic flow for both eye care and aesthetics services.
  • Patient Records: Maintain and update patient records accurately, ensuring confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA standards.
  • Insurance Coordination: Verify insurance eligibility for eye care services, handle prior authorizations, and assist patients with insurance-related questions.

  • Patient Education: Provide basic information to patients about eye health, aesthetics procedures, and follow-up care instructions, as directed by the clinical professionals.
  • Post-Treatment Assistance: Provide patients with aftercare instructions for aesthetics treatments and eye care procedures, ensuring they understand recovery steps and product usage.
  • Product Sales Support: Assist with the sale of recommended skincare products, eye care products, or cosmetics, explaining benefits as advised by the clinic specialists.
  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with clinical staff in both eye care and aesthetics to ensure seamless patient care and clinic efficiency.

Qualifications

  • Education: Medical Background is a plus
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in a healthcare or customer service setting, preferably in an eye clinic, aesthetic clinic, or similar medical environment.
  • Skills:
    • Strong English communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Proficient in medical scheduling software and basic office software (e.g., Microsoft Office).
    • Detail-oriented with the ability to multitask in a busy clinical environment.
    • Knowledge of insurance verification and billing processes is preferred.
    • Bilingual skills (especially in Spanish) are a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Empathy and Patience: Show compassion and understanding towards patients, especially those who may be anxious about their appointments or treatments.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to address patient issues proactively and work collaboratively to resolve them.
  • Organizational Skills: Maintain patient records and appointment schedules accurately and efficiently.

Device Requirements:

  • Processor: Intel iCore 5, Ryzen 5, or higher
  • RAM: 16GB or more
  • Setup: Dual Monitor
  • Accessories: Noise-canceling headset & camera

You’ll own core backend features end-to-end: from modeling the data to implementing the logic and exposing it through fast, reliable services that ship to users quickly, working with a small distributed team across several countries.

💰 $100 bonus: After successfully completing the assessment. To receive the assessment,
please submit your resume to this job application. If your resume is approved, you'll receive the

assessment afterwards.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement backend servicesand APIs using Python+ Django (and DRF or similar).

  • Model and evolve our domain in the database with clean, well-structured schemas and relationships.

  • Implement algorithmic/AI logicin the backend (e.g., scoring, ranking, routing, decision rules).

  • Write pragmatic, production-ready code that’s easy to reason about and iterate on.

  • Optimize for correctness and performance: efficient queries, smart indexing, and lean responses.

  • Work with the team to turn product ideas into concrete technical designs and endpoints.

  • Help shape how we build things: patterns, conventions, and how we ship and iterate as we grow.

  • Strong experience building backend applications with Python + Django.

  • Solid understanding of relational data modeling and SQL (we use PostgreSQL).

  • Comfortable designing and building RESTful APIs (bonus if you’ve used DRF or similarframeworks).

  • Experience working onnon-trivial business logic or algorithms (e.g., decision flows,scoring rules, optimization logic).

  • Good instincts aroundperformance: understanding query behavior, avoiding obviouspitfalls, and using caching when it counts.

  • Astartup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, moving fast, and iterating based on real-world feedback.

  • Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and/or serverless on GCP.

This role is a central piece of our backend roadmap, and we’re aiming to fill it quickly once we meet the right person. If it resonates with you, go ahead and apply now.

About the role

As an Engineering Manager, you will drive the successful delivery and execution of projects within your teams. You will manage end-to-end technical planning, ensuring that product requirements are translated into actionable tasks, while orchestrating collaboration between various stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, QA, and UX. This role requires a deep understanding of software design and development and the ability to plan, execute, and deliver product features in a timely and predictable manner. You will also be responsible for maintaining high technical standards, managing team bandwidth, and ensuring project milestones are met with efficiency and accuracy.

What you’ll get to do

  • Own end-to-end delivery and execution across cross-functional teams within your product area, ensuring predictable and high-quality outcomes.
  • Evaluate business and product requirements for technical feasibility and architectural alignment, translating them into well-defined EPICs and technical user stories.

  • Plan and drive sprint execution with clearly defined goals, using project planning tools to establish timelines, delivery milestones, and surface dependencies early.
  • Champion engineering processes and rituals that enable strong collaboration, accountability, and team efficiency.
  • Monitor team velocity and capacity to optimize resource allocation, proactively balancing bandwidth against delivery commitments.
  • Coordinate cross-team dependencies and stakeholder alignment to remove bottlenecks and maintain smooth execution.
  • Stay hands-on in critical initiatives by guiding design decisions, enforcing sound design patterns, and participating in code reviews to maintain high engineering quality.
  • Ensure robust monitoring, alerting, and observability for all owned services, consistently meeting defined SLIs and SLOs.
  • Partner with Product Managers to define, track, and publish post-release product metrics, driving transparency and continuous improvement.

To succeed in this role, you should have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 8-10 years of experience as a Software Developer, Software Engineer, or in a similar hands-on technical role.
  • 5+ years of strong experience building production systems using Java and Spring Boot.

Generic Skills

  • Feedback: Conduct regular performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and fostering a growth-oriented environment.

About the team

The Senior Specialist, Business Intelligence leverages advanced analytics, data modeling, and visualization to translate complex business questions into actionable insights that inform strategic and operational decisions. Partnering closely with product, marketing, and operations stakeholders, this role designs and maintains robust BI solutions and self-service reporting, improves data quality and accessibility, and mentors others on data-driven decision making.

About the role

Define the vision: For each marketing domain, leading with a strong point of view on what the end-state intelligence product should be, informed by stakeholder input and an understanding of today’s gaps, and building a strategic case for what to build, for whom, and why

Strategic thought partner to marketing leaders: Pressure-testing what stakeholders think they need, challenging assumptions, and aligning on the intelligence investments that will have the greatest impact on decisions and outcomes

Translate strategy into specs: Outlining mockups, data requirements, and prioritized feature sets with enough detail for BI analysts to build from, prototyping and validating concepts using available data and tools before committing to full builds

Drive adoption post-launch: Monitoring usage, diagnosing where adoption stalls, and iterating on products until they are embedded in day-to-day workflows

Incorporate AI capabilities: Defining AI-related needs where they make products more actionable such as automated insight surfacing, anomaly detection, or natural language interaction

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $118,600.00 - $189,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $112,700.00 - $179,900.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 8+ years in marketing analytics, media analytics, or strategic analytics -ideally shaping analytical approaches and recommendations, not just executing against predefined briefs. Experience at analytics consultancies, media agencies, or specialized firms (e.g., marketing mix, attribution) highly valued

  • Marketing fluency: Strong familiarity with marketing data and analytics needs, including deep fluency in at least one domain such as paid media, owned media, or marketing measurement

  • Business acumen: Able to quickly grasp business context and objectives, ensuring that marketing insights, performance metrics, and intelligence products directly connect to core business outcomes

  • Hands-on technical skills: Experience with SQL and dashboarding tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI), with the ability to work directly with data to prototype and iterate

  • Consultative mindset: Track record of digging into how stakeholders make decisions, pushing past surface-level requests, and delivering higher-impact solutions

  • Executive communication: Able to present a strategic point of view with clarity and confidence, and challenge constructively while maintaining trust

  • Strategic agility: Able to ramp quickly in unfamiliar areas, build credibility with new stakeholder groups, and independently structure a path forward

  • AI curiosity: Genuine interest in experimenting with AI tools and incorporating AI-augmented capabilities into analytics work; deep expertise not required

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s in a quantitative or business field (MBA, MSBA, Economics, Statistics) a plus

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

B&G Foods is seeking an experienced Supplier Quality Manager to lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of supplier quality and food safety programs across our ingredients within the spice, seasoning, seed, herb and flavor/additives supply base. This position is responsible for ensuring suppliers meet B&G Foods' quality, food safety, regulatory, and customer requirements while driving risk reduction and continuous improvement throughout the supply chain.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in supplier quality management within the food manufacturing industry, with significant experience in the spices, seasonings, herbs, dehydrated ingredients, and flavor systems. This role requires strong technical knowledge of supplier approval and monitoring programs, food safety auditing, regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and supplier performance management.

Supplier Qualification & Approval

  • Lead the supplier approval, qualification, and requalification programs for ingredients including: spices, seasonings, herbs, dehydrated ingredients, and flavor systems.
  • Evaluate supplier food safety systems, quality management systems, regulatory compliance, and operational capabilities.
  • Perform risk-based supplier assessments and establish supplier risk ratings.

Supplier Auditing

  • Conduct supplier audits and assessments at domestic and international manufacturing facilities.
  • Issue audit reports and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).
  • Monitor supplier corrective action effectiveness and closure.

  • Partner with Procurement, Operations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to ensure supplier compliance and business continuity.

  • Support internal and external audits.
  • Maintain supplier quality procedures, policies, and standards.

Required

  • Demonstrated experience auditing food manufacturing facilities.
  • Experience managing supplier corrective actions and continuous improvement programs.

Preferred

  • Experience in the spice, seasoning, herb, flavor, botanical, or agricultural ingredient industries.

  • PCQI certification.
  • Experience with global sourcing and international supplier networks.
  • Knowledge of food fraud, food defense, and ingredient authenticity programs.

Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

Overview

We are looking for a Director, UX Researchto join the Customer Insights team at Collectors and lead our UX research function. This is an exciting time to join the growing collectibles space. This role will have the unique opportunity to shape a suite of products to help card collectors grade, sell, manage and enjoy their collections.

You will lead the UX research team to deeply understand the people behind the collections and how our products can meet their needs. We need a leader who is skilled at prioritizing what research will drive the biggest impact and weighing how different research methods are best suited for each ask.

Remote or hybrid candidates (close to Santa Ana or Jersey City offices) will be considered. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.

What You’ll Do

  • Set Research Strategy: Define and drive the UX research roadmap by identifying critical knowledge gaps and prioritizing work that influences company-level decisions.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a senior partner to Marketing, Product, Design, and Engineering leads to weave the right insights together and drive decision making.

  • Execute Research: Both independently conduct andguide team members on the design and execution of generative, formative, and summative research to support product design and development (including but not limited to ethnography, interviews, surveys, concept testing, and usability studies)

  • Team Leadership: Mentor the user research team. Set clear direction, mentor team members, and establish a high bar for research craft.

Who You Are

  • Experienced UX Leader: 7+ years of experience in user research, preferably with experience in consumer technology, collectibles, sports or fandom. You are an experienced people manager (2+ years of experience). You know what "excellent" looks like and how to coach others to get there.

  • Master of Craft: You possess a broad methodology range (qualitative and quantitative) and have a track record of research that has moved the needle on real-world business outcomes. You have the ability to moderate interviews and conduct user research independently.

  • Strategic Thinker: You can translate ambiguous problem spaces into clear research questions and connect findings to product strategy with confidence. You understand when different data points/methodology is required to make the most compelling case (e.g., primary research vs. behavioral data, usability vs. market research study, etc.).

  • Master Storyteller: You can land a narrative regardless of the audience—from a small product squad to a senior leadership forum.

  • Collaborative Partner: You build buy-in and navigate competing priorities with grace. You are known as an honest, transparent partner at every level of the organization.

  • Adaptable & Tech-Forward: You understand how AI is transforming research. You encourage experimentation with new tools while holding the line on quality and rigor.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $163,308 - $267,038. Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation.

  • Health Insurance: All full-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • Additional Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits

  • 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals

  • Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time-off

  • Holiday Pay: All regular, full-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays

  • Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions

  • Flexible Hours: Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs

  • Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities

Location: 100% Remote (Global)
Timezone / Hours: Flexible working hours, with a requirement for partial overlap with US business hours (PT/ET) for synchronous team collaboration and meetings.
Engagement Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.

We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

We are a profitable, previously Silicon Valley-backed, fully remote company, and we are not just looking to improve manufacturing, we are looking for a visionary operator to help us truly revolutionize the global supply chain.

💻 The Role

We're not looking for a traditional data analyst. We don't need someone to sit between our systems and the business interpreting what the numbers mean. We need a builder who can take a stated requirement ("we need this tracked," "alert us when this breaks") and ship it: a dashboard, an automated pipeline, or a real-time alert.

A significant part of this role is exposing what’s already happening across our platforms: tracking when something enters a process, when it exits, and pinpointing where it gets stuck. This is closer to an automation and systems engineering role than classic business intelligence. You will work alongside our core engineering team and our Automation Engineer to connect, clean, and automate our entire data ecosystem.

We would rather hire someone scrappy and technical who figures things out (researches, builds, breaks things, and fixes them) than someone with a polished analytics background who needs well-defined problems handed to them.

The Big Vision

You will own data across the entire organization. We are actively moving away from static dashboards and toward an AI-powered data engine where team members can type in natural-language queries, and the engine automatically fetches, processes, and analyzes the data in real time.

Ultimately, you will build the central data heart of THE/STUDIO—a system where automated, data-driven decisions execute seamlessly across our operations.

🎯 What You’ll Do

  • Architect the AI Data Engine:Build toward our long-term vision of an AI-driven, natural-language query interface and contribute to automating operational decision-making across the business.

  • Build Automated Pipelines & Dashboards:Design self-sustaining systems (e.g., Looker/Looker Studio or equivalent BI tools) where metrics populate automatically with zero manual pulling.

  • Ship End-to-End Solutions Independently:Take raw requirements from managers and build working systems without needing a formal spec or data translator.

  • Deploy Real-Time Alerting:Build triggers that instantly flag process breakdowns or deviations, moving from retrospective reporting to proactive mitigation.

  • Expose Process Timestamps:Surface stage-by-stage system events (entry/exit timestamps) across our core platforms to identify and fix operational bottlenecks.

  • Engineer Workflow Automations: Build and maintain automated workflows (e.g., via n8n) linking our raw data sources directly to reporting and alerting tools.

  • Solve Root-Cause Data Issues: Fix data quality and integrity issues directly at the source.

  • Leverage AI as a Default: Use modern AI tools as a core build accelerant in your day-to-day workflow.

  • Document for Enablement:Create clear, lightweight documentation so non-technical managers can use and navigate tools independently.

Requirements:

  • A Builder & Engineer Mindset:You thrive when handed an ambiguous problem, navigating it through research, experimentation, and execution.

  • Technical Foundation:Hands-on fluency with SQL and cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery or equivalent). Note: This is a foundational baseline, not the entire job.

  • Tooling Proficiency:Deep experience with BI dashboarding (e.g., Looker Studio) and workflow automation platforms (e.g., n8n, Make, or custom scripts).

  • End-to-End Ownership:Proven track record of building and deploying functional tools from scratch, not just querying existing databases.

  • AI-First Workflows:Heavy daily reliance on AI tools to accelerate development, write code, and build system prototypes.

  • Direct Stakeholder Communication:Comfortable talking directly to business leads to extract requirements without needing formal spec processes.

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)

Our Founder/CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

  1. Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

  2. "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line.

  3. Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding.

💰 Compensation & Terms

  • Flexible & Competitive: We offer competitive, outcome-driven compensation packages tailored to the candidate's level of impact.

  • Engagement Type: Full-time, exclusive independent contractor role.

🔎 Our Hiring Process

  1. Submit Application: IMPORTANT! Please submit your resume/CV in English

  2. Initial Screen: Brief intro chat to evaluate mutual fit, communications, and expectations.

  3. Hiring Manager Interview: Deep dive into your hard skills, past track record, and problem-solving approach.

  4. Assessment / Case Study:(If applicable for the role) Practical demonstration of your capabilities.

  5. Final Executive Interview: Conversation with key team members.

  6. Reference Checks: Verification of past performance with former leaders and CEOs.

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide feedback to all applications.

raw.description:
About Magic
Magic is a leading modern outsourcing platform that connects SMBs to high-quality remote workers, from SDRs to virtual assistants and more. With roots in Silicon Valley, and backing from top venture capitalists, our workers are supercharged with a combination of the latest AI technology and training. We came out of Y Combinator in 2015, have grown to 1,000+ remote workers, and are backed by Sequoia Capital with over $30M in funding.

Background
Founded: 2015 · Funding: $30M (Y Combinator, Sequoia backed) · Industry: HRTech, Virtual Assistant Platform · Employees: 672 · HQ: San Francisco, CA / Manila, PH
  • Check out Magic's Business Profile
  • Know more about our Team via Magic's Careers Page﻿﻿
Why does this role exist?

This is a full-time, in-house role at Magic — not freelance, and not a placement with a single client.
You'll build and hold candidate pipelines for niche, hard-to-fill roles — running Boolean searches across LinkedIn, job boards, and online communities, then screening and scheduling before a recruiter ever steps in. On custom, high-touch hires, you'll run sourcing, outreach, screening, and scheduling in a single day.
This isn't a full-cycle recruiting seat — you won't be running interviews or making offers. What you will do is make the call, before anyone else sees a resume, on whether a candidate is strong enough to move forward.
What You'll Actually Do

Sourcing Research
You'll hunt down candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, social platforms, and online communities — running Boolean searches and testing keyword combinations until the right people surface. You're building pipelines for the reqs open today and the ones opening next month, and logging all of it in Penthouse, Magic's in-house ATS, so nothing gets lost.

Coordination Handoff

You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with recruiters to understand exactly what "qualified" means for each req, then keep sourcing paced to their timelines. For niche and custom requests, you're also the one getting candidates onto the calendar — scheduling is part of the job, not an afterthought.

Candidate Engagement Screening

You're the first filter before anyone else sees a resume — reaching out, gauging real interest, and screening for fit before you endorse anyone up the chain. You'll keep candidates warm with real communication, not templated silence, because a good pipeline is really just a lot of relationships you didn't let go cold.

What Winning Looks Like

  • You keep a pipeline moving even when half of it has gone quiet — you re-engage instead of waiting around.
  • You can lose a whole day to one complicated custom req and still hit your other numbers.
  • You can tell a great candidate from a good-on-paper one before a recruiter ever opens the profile.
  • You hit your targets — Matching Interview Pass Rate, Hire Hit Rate, Drop-off Rate, Daily Endorsements — without cutting corners to get there.
  • Recruiters trust your handoffs, because they're clean every time, not just when it's convenient.

Your Superpowers
  • Adaptability
  • Attention to Detail
  • Boolean Search Mastery
  • Self-Direction
  • Challenge-Ready Mindset
  • Clear Communication

What You Bring

  • 1–3 years of dedicated sourcing experience — this is a sourcing seat, not a full-cycle recruiting one, so we're looking for someone who already thinks like a sourcer.
  • A track record finding candidates for niche or hard-to-fill roles across LinkedIn, job boards, social platforms, and online communities.
  • Hands-on Boolean search and keyword optimization skills.
  • Comfortable running multiple sourcing requests and accounts at once in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.
  • Professional English, written and verbal.
  • WFH setup: 8GB+ RAM with an Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better, 40 Mbps+ internet with backup, noise-cancelling headset with mic and webcam, backup computer and connection, quiet dedicated workspace.

Our Hiring Process
Application → Recruiter Screening → Hiring Manager Interview → Final Interview → Job Offer


The Reality
This role sits within Magic's Boutique team, supporting recruiters across general, niche, and custom-hire requisitions — everything from SDRs and bookkeepers to project managers and full custom accounts. The pool for niche and custom roles is often small, so real sourcing work is the norm, not the exception, and priorities can flip from a slow-burn niche search to an all-day custom-hire sprint without warning.
Shift: 9 AM–6 PM PHT (flexible start options: 7 AM–4 PM or 8 AM–5 PM), Monday–Friday, reporting to the Recruitment Manager. Your first 30 days are fully dedicated to onboarding — ramping into Magic's tools and processes, including full training on Penthouse. KPI expectations begin at Day 90: Matching Interview Pass Rate ≥60% (monthly), Hire Hit Rate ≥15%, Drop-off Rate 5%, and Daily Endorsements of 1–3 for niche reqs or 8 for custom hires.

Before You Apply — Quick Gut Check
  • Can you go from a slow-burn niche search to an all-day sourcing-and-scheduling sprint without losing your rhythm?
  • Are you comfortable building a pipeline from nothing but a Boolean string and good instinct?
  • Can you tell a great candidate from a good-on-paper one before a recruiter ever sees the profile?
  • Is your WFH setup ready (8GB+ RAM, i5/Ryzen 5, 40+ Mbps internet, noise-cancelling headset)?
If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What's In It For You

  • ₱32,000–₱38,000 per month
  • 100% remote, Philippines-based
  • HMO, government-mandated benefits (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), 13th month pay, and paid time off
  • Full training provided on Penthouse, Magic's in-house ATS — no prior ATS experience required
